description: We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape patient care standards, foster a supportive environment for nursing staff, and ensure the highest quality of service delivery. The ideal candidate will be a compassionate leader with a strong commitment to excellence in long-term care.As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of nursing operations, including staff management, regulatory compliance, and the implementation of best practices in patient care. This role is crucial for maintaining a high standard of clinical outcomes and resident satisfaction. Join a team dedicated to making a meaningful difference in the lives of residents.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 3-5 years of nursing experience, with at least 2 years in a leadership or supervisory role
Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
